```{r}
library(GEOquery)
library(affy)
library(limma)
library("pheatmap")
library(plotly)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
```

- Download the data
-->getGEO will download the matrix.txt for metadata info
-->getGEOSuppFiles will download CEL or txt files per sample
```{r}
gse<-getGEO('GSE103465')
gse<-gse[[1]]
phenotype_data<-pData(gse)
geo_accession<- "GSE103465"
raw_data_dir <- "<original_archive>/MICROARRAY_DATA/GSE103465"
getGEOSuppFiles(geo_accession, makeDirectory = TRUE, baseDir = raw_data_dir)
untar(file.path(raw_data_dir, paste0(geo_accession, "_RAW.tar")), exdir=raw_data_dir)
```

```{r}
output_dir<-"<original_archive>/MICROARRAY_DATA/GSE103465/txt_files"
gz_files<-list.files(raw_data_dir, pattern = "\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE)
for (file in gz_files) {
  dest_file <- file.path(output_dir, gsub("\\.gz$", "", basename(file)))
  R.utils::gunzip(file, destname = dest_file, remove = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
cel_files <- list.files("<original_archive>/MICROARRAY_DATA/GSE103465/txt_files", 
                        pattern = "\\.CEL$", 
                        full.names = TRUE)
cel_data <-ReadAffy(filenames=cel_files)
expr_data<-exprs(cel_data)
```

PCA analysis: before normalization
```{r, fig.height=12, fig.width=8}
# Transpose the data to have samples as rows and genes as columns
expr_data_t <- t(expr_data)
colnames(expr_data_t) <- paste0("Gene", 1:ncol(expr_data_t))

# Perform PCA
pca_result <- prcomp(expr_data_t, scale. = TRUE)

# Extract PCA scores for the first three principal components
pca_scores <- data.frame(pca_result$x[, 1:3])
colnames(pca_scores) <- c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")

# Add sample labels
pca_scores$Sample <- rownames(pca_scores)

# Add condition labels (manually in this example, modify as needed for your data)
pca_scores$Condition <- c("Control", "Control", "Control", "RIF", "RIF", "RIF")

# Calculate % variance explained for the first three PCs
explained_variance <- round(100 * pca_result$sdev[1:3]^2 / sum(pca_result$sdev^2), 1)

# Create a 3D PCA plot using plotly
plot_ly(
  pca_scores,
  x = ~PC1,
  y = ~PC2,
  z = ~PC3,
  color = ~Condition,
  colors = c("blue", "red"),  # Adjust colors for Control and RIF
  text = ~paste("Sample:", Sample),  # Add sample labels as hover text
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers+text",  # Add point labels
  textposition = "top center"  # Position labels
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "3D PCA of Expression Data",
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = paste0("PC1 (", explained_variance[1], "% variance)")),
      yaxis = list(title = paste0("PC2 (", explained_variance[2], "% variance)")),
      zaxis = list(title = paste0("PC3 (", explained_variance[3], "% variance)"))
    )
  )

```
Normalization and background correction
```{r}
rma_data<-rma(cel_data)
#extract the expression data
expr_norm_data<-exprs(rma_data)
```

```{r, fig.height=14, fig.width=10}
# Assuming you have the expression matrix `expr_norm_data` and sample conditions
# Sample conditions: Add a data frame with the condition for each sample
sample_conditions <- data.frame(
  Condition = c("Control", "Control", "Control", "RIF", "RIF", "RIF")
)
rownames(sample_conditions) <- colnames(expr_norm_data)  # Ensure rownames match the sample names

# Calculate mean expression for each gene across samples
gene_mean_expression <- rowMeans(expr_norm_data)

# Select the top 100 most expressed genes
top_genes <- order(gene_mean_expression, decreasing = TRUE)[1:1000]
expr_top_genes <- expr_norm_data[top_genes, ]

# Scale the data for better visualization
expr_top_genes_scaled <- t(scale(t(expr_top_genes)))

# Generate the heatmap with annotations
pheatmap(
  expr_top_genes_scaled,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,   # Cluster genes
  cluster_cols = TRUE,   # Cluster samples
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50), # Color gradient
  annotation_col = sample_conditions, # Add sample conditions
  main = "Heatmap of Top 100 Most Expressed Genes",
  fontsize = 10
)

```
downloading annotation file
```{r}
# Download the platform files for annotation
gpl <- getGEO("GPL16043", AnnotGPL = TRUE)
# Convert to data frames
gpl_annot <- Table(gpl)
# Check for relevant columns, typically "ID" and "Gene Symbol" or similar
colnames(gpl_annot)
# Extract the relevant mapping for GPL17077
annotation_map <- gpl_annot[, c("ID", "Gene Symbol")]
```


MERGING DATA TO ANNOTATION FILE
```{r}
#First need to convert normalized data into a data frame and add in a column for probe ID so it can correspond with the annotation map (for aggregation)
# Add probe IDs as a column to expr_norm_data
expr_norm_df <- as.data.frame(expr_norm_data)  # Convert matrix to data frame
expr_norm_df$ProbeID <- rownames(expr_norm_data)
# Move ProbeID to the front for clarity
expr_norm_df <- expr_norm_df[, c("ProbeID", setdiff(colnames(expr_norm_df), "ProbeID"))]

# Change column names
colnames(annotation_map)[colnames(annotation_map) == "ID"] <- "ProbeID"
colnames(annotation_map)[colnames(annotation_map) == "Gene Symbol"] <- "Gene_Symbol"

```

Aggregation (based on the ProbeID column)
```{r}
# Merge normalized expression data with annotation table
annotated_expr_df <- merge(expr_norm_df, annotation_map, by = "ProbeID", all.x = TRUE)
# Remove rows where GeneSymbol is NA, empty string, or ---
annotated_expr_df <- annotated_expr_df[!(is.na(annotated_expr_df$Gene_Symbol) | annotated_expr_df$Gene_Symbol == "" | annotated_expr_df$Gene_Symbol == "---"), ]
```
Save annotation file locally
```{r}
#write.csv(annotated_expr_df, "annotated_expr_GSE103465.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

DE Analysis
- what we have currently: annotated data frame with the normalized data and gene symbols

```{r}
# Collapse by GeneSymbol, retaining subject-specific expression
collapsed_expr_df <- annotated_expr_df %>%
  group_by(Gene_Symbol) %>%  
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean)) %>%  # Aggregate by mean (per subject)
  ungroup()  # Remove grouping
# Convert back to data frame
collapsed_expr_df <- as.data.frame(collapsed_expr_df)
# Set GeneSymbol as row names
rownames(collapsed_expr_df) <- collapsed_expr_df$Gene_Symbol
collapsed_expr_df <- collapsed_expr_df[, -1]  # Remove GeneSymbol column after setting row names
```


Adjust sample names to "control" and "RIF"
- using "title" column from phenotype_data
```{r}
# Update 'title' column based on keywords "control" or "RIF"
phenotype_data <- phenotype_data %>%
  mutate(title = case_when(
    grepl("control", title, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Control",  # If 'control' is found, set title to "Control"
    grepl("RIF", title, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "RIF",         # If 'RIF' is found, set title to "RIF"
    TRUE ~ title  # Keep original value if neither is matched
  ))

#Adjust names within the collapsed_expr_df
# Ensure the number of columns in collapsed_expr_df matches the number of geo_accession entries
if (length(colnames(collapsed_expr_df)) == length(phenotype_data$geo_accession)) {
  
  # Rename the columns in collapsed_expr_df to match geo_accession
  colnames(collapsed_expr_df) <- phenotype_data$geo_accession
  
  # Verify the updated column names
  print("Updated column names based on geo_accession:")
  print(colnames(collapsed_expr_df))
  
} else {
  stop("Mismatch: Number of expression data columns and geo_accession entries do not match.")
}

```
Set up design matrix
```{r}
group<-factor(phenotype_data$title, levels = c("Control","RIF"))
levels(group) <- make.names(levels(group))
#Design model matrix
design<-model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
colnames(design)<-levels(group)
# Fit linear model
fit <- lmFit(collapsed_expr_df, design)
```

Make contrast matrix and run DE analysis
```{r}
contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(Control_vs_RIF = Control-RIF, levels = design)
fit2<-contrasts.fit(fit,contrast_matrix)
fit2<-eBayes(fit2)
```

Assess and filter DEG results
```{r}
deg_results <- topTable(fit2, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "P", number = Inf)
#Filter
deg_results<-deg_results[abs(deg_results$logFC)>=log2(1) & deg_results$P.Value<=0.05,]
results <- decideTests(fit2, lfc = 1, adjust.method = "none")

```
